summary: An amount with its currency, picked at the start of the field, its sign beside the value, grouped for the locale when the field is left.

props.name: label
props.description: Text above the field, wired to it as its accessible name.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the field invalid and shows this under it in place of `description`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The amount on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the amount, or `null` when the field is cleared.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency, as an ISO code, controlled. Pair with `onCurrencyChange`.

props.name: defaultCurrency
props.description: The currency on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: onCurrencyChange
props.description: Called with the ISO code when another currency is picked.

props.name: currencies
props.description: The ISO codes the picker offers. One code hides the picker.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formats the grouping, the decimal mark and the currency names.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the field and its popup. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks the field and the picker and dims both.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and adds an asterisk to the label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the field. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: The picker list rendering inside this element instead of the page, for a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.

props.label: Budget
props.description: Grouped when you leave the field.
